title: ネバー・エンディング・ロード

text_block_list.text: While Air Groove and I are on our way to training…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Yes, but you know Air Groove. She would never…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yup… And the racewear…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's all this about me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um… Well…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you have something to say, just say it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, you see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We were just saying how pretty your new racewear was.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's very elegant! And you wear it so well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So we were just chatting about wanting to see it up close.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see. If that's the case, then I'm honored to hear it.
choice_data_list: Why don't you give them a little fashion show?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why? We have training to get to. There's no time for that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's what I figured…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: S-sorry to bother you…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Very well. Just this once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, here I am.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wow… With racewear this good, it's like a work of art even when you're just standing there…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That’s not true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Simply wearing signature racewear is not the end of it. Rather, it's merely the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The beauty of the racewear lies in how it complements a well-trained body, fit to perform on the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In other words, the design of the clothing means little on its own. It can only truly shine if you put in the effort to become worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm still… not all the way there myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're first-rate in our eyes, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You two…
choice_data_list: We need to keep on improving ourselves.
We need to keep on improving ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You two…
choice_data_list: We need to keep on improving ourselves.
We need to keep on improving ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that is my intention. Becoming worthy of one's racewear is a journey without end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you wish to wear it, you must be constantly improving yourself. Unlike a race, this path has no finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No finish line? Sounds exhausting…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But therein lies its true worth. At least, I think so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, we really do have to get to our training. Please excuse us.
With that, we head off to training.
Their glittering eyes watch us the whole way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not you too…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, fine. I accept your praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, I personally am not satisfied with where I am. I'll continue to polish my skills and seek to shine ever brighter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, Dober, I expect you two to hone yourselves as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hone yourselves until you shine brighter than anyone else.
Air Groove and I head to training, leaving the pair awestruck behind us.
